title: Iced Coffee Granita Sundae
changes_from_base: A no-churn condensed-milk ice cream, coffee granita and cocoa-coffee syrup replace the bought ice cream and hot fudge.
summary: A sophisticated iced coffee dessert combining granita, ice cream and a silky chocolate-coffee syrup. Layers of texture and layers of flavour.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Granita
steps.text: Dissolve 100 g caster sugar in 530 ml very strong hot black coffee, pour into a shallow lidded tub and cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Syrup
steps.text: Stir the remaining 300 ml coffee with 100 g caster sugar and 2 tsp cocoa powder until dissolved, cover and chill.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Whisk together 460 g sweetened condensed milk, 480 ml single cream, 240 ml crème fraîche, 1 tsp vanilla and 1 pinch salt; pour into another shallow tub.

steps.title: Break
steps.text: Whisk the cream mixture hard to break the ice crystals, then freeze for 4 h or overnight.

steps.title: Rake
steps.text: Rake the granita with a fork every hour for about 3 h until fully crystalline, or freeze overnight and rake again just before serving.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Alternate scoops of the frozen cream mixture with the granita in a tall glass.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour the chilled chocolate-coffee syrup over and scatter with 40 g dark chocolate shards if desired.

tips: Rake the granita hourly for the first few hours to break down the ice crystals into fine snow.
Use very strong coffee for maximum flavour intensity.
The granita and ice cream can be made the day before for convenience.
storage: Keep the granita and the ice cream covered in the freezer and the syrup covered in the fridge; rake the granita again just before serving.
